title: [11] Improve friend adding flow with invite links and mutual requests
why_we_need_this: Currently both users must manually search for each other to become friends, which is cumbersome and unintuitive. A simpler flow (e.g. shareable invite link, QR code, or one-sided friend request that the other person just accepts) would significantly improve the onboarding and social experience.
acceptance_criteria:
- User can send a friend request that the other person accepts or declines (no need for both to search)
- User can generate a shareable invite link or QR code to add them as a friend
- Recipient of an invite link/QR code is added as a friend after confirmation
- Friend requests show as notifications with accept/decline actions
- Works cross-platform (web, iOS, Android, desktop)
